title: Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards Members on Ridgeline Pro Credit — Member Reduction of a Re-Rated Late Fee
content:
**Clause.** When the most recent late fee on a Ridgeline Pro Credit revolving account is re-rated, the ProBuild member reduction is a dollar amount taken off the scheduled late fee, the reduced fee never falling below zero. It is set by the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership and its ProBuild spend:

| The business's active Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership | Net ProBuild qualifying spend in the last 12 months | ProBuild member reduction |
|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Silver, Gold, Platinum or Platinum Elite | At least 10000.00 | 5.00 (Silver member reduction) |
| ProBuild Member or ProBuild Bronze | At least 10000.00 | 2.00 (basic member reduction) |
| Any other case — net spend below 10000.00, or no active membership | | Zero |

## Net spend

The net spend is the ProBuild qualifying spend posted on the business's Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards activity in the last 12 months, net of spend reversed in the same 12 months; the 12 months are whole calendar months counted back from the correction date.

## Cases (hypothetical, scheduled late fee 32.00)

| Membership | Net spend | Reduction | Scheduled fee after this reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| ProBuild Gold | 18000.00 | 5.00 | 27.00 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 10000.00 | 2.00 | 30.00 |
| ProBuild Bronze | 9999.99 | 0.00 | 32.00 |
| ProBuild Platinum | 4000.00 | 0.00 | 32.00 |
